groups.saying_opens: إن العبد إذا وضع في قبره وتولى عنه
أنه يفسح له في قبره سبعون ذراعا

notes: Two sayings, each stored: the Prophet's report through Anas (saying 1) and Qatada's own addendum «قال قتادة وذكر لنا» with no named transmitter (saying 2).
Saying 2 is the one the text hangs on «وذكر لنا», which is a gap, so its last link is unnamed.
